paths.name: Default full workflow, Enter-heavy happy path
paths.user_intent: Accept defaults and run a complete subtitle workflow.
paths.notes: Shows whether defaults feel safe when the user keeps pressing Enter.

paths.name: Local Plex folder with missing languages, then fetch
paths.user_intent: Work from a local folder and search online for missing subtitles.
paths.notes: Important for users who start from Plex folders instead of catalog URLs.

paths.name: Japanese learner adds hiragana reading aid
paths.user_intent: Turn Japanese + English subtitles into a learner-friendly file.
paths.notes: Primary beginner copy path for furigana/reading-aid explanation.

paths.name: Korean learner adds Revised Romanization
paths.user_intent: Stack Korean and English with Korean romanization.
paths.notes: Ensures the wizard is not Japanese-only in tone or examples.

paths.name: Merge-only local folder
paths.user_intent: Combine existing subtitles without fetching or modifying.
paths.notes: A common power-user workflow that should stay short.

paths.name: Modify-only single subtitle file
paths.user_intent: Clean or add reading aids to one subtitle file.
paths.notes: Checks that single-file input does not imply a whole season.

paths.name: Rename-only episode range
paths.user_intent: Batch rename subtitle filenames while keeping originals safe.
paths.notes: Rename is destructive-adjacent; copywriting must make copy vs original obvious.

paths.name: DeepL selected without API key
paths.user_intent: Use DeepL before setup is complete.
paths.notes: Failure should feel recoverable, not like a crash.

paths.name: Ollama selected but daemon/model unavailable
paths.user_intent: Use local AI translation before Ollama is ready.
paths.notes: Good test for plain-English dependency copy.

paths.name: Requested language missing from local folder
paths.user_intent: Merge languages that are not actually present locally.
paths.notes: Should teach the user what the folder contains and what to try next.

paths.name: Skip AI translation intentionally
paths.user_intent: Accept gaps instead of translating.
paths.notes: Skipping MT is a valid choice; warnings should not sound like errors.

paths.name: Crunchyroll season page with absolute episode numbers
paths.user_intent: Fetch a whole visible Crunchyroll season that starts at E25.
paths.notes: Most important scope copy for anime streaming pages.

paths.name: Local video file should scope to one episode
paths.user_intent: Operate on one selected episode file only.
paths.notes: Regression guard against accidentally scanning a whole season.

paths.name: Open folder after run
paths.user_intent: Open the result folder without re-running post steps.
paths.notes: Protects against the old double-dispatch bug.

paths.name: Finder drag-drop quoted path
paths.user_intent: Paste a quoted path from Finder/Terminal.
paths.notes: Mac users commonly paste paths wrapped in quotes.

paths.name: Quoted path stripped before validation
paths.user_intent: Use a path with shell-style quotes.
paths.notes: A tighter regression trap for quoted path handling.

paths.name: Free text entered at Q1 instead of choosing a mode
paths.user_intent: Type a title into the first selection prompt.
paths.notes: Checks that the error explains how to search by title.

paths.name: Q1 rejects free text and recovers
paths.user_intent: Recover after entering non-menu text.
paths.notes: Similar to path 17 but covers the trap path explicitly.

paths.name: Back navigation through a previous step
paths.user_intent: Correct a previous answer without restarting.
paths.notes: Back should move one logical question, not lose unrelated answers.

paths.name: Start-over selected but user declines discard
paths.user_intent: Avoid losing answers after picking restart by mistake.
paths.notes: Restart is a destructive workflow action and needs confirmation.

paths.name: Edit a single answer from final screen
paths.user_intent: Change one answer after reviewing the plan.
paths.notes: Covers the final-action edit branch.

paths.name: Save reusable TOML, then override later
paths.user_intent: Create a reusable workflow for future runs.
paths.notes: Important copy for non-programmers learning what a workflow file does.

paths.name: TOML save includes override hint and open-folder prompt
paths.user_intent: Save a workflow and understand how CLI overrides work.
paths.notes: Pins the post-save educational copy.

paths.name: URL-first fetch workflow
paths.user_intent: Start from an IMDb/catalog URL.
paths.notes: Common path for users who do not have local subtitle files yet.

paths.name: DeepL engine maps correctly in CLI/TOML
paths.user_intent: Save a DeepL translation workflow.
paths.notes: Protects against Argos/DeepL wording and emission mixups.

paths.name: Enter accepts defaults at yes/no and menu prompts
paths.user_intent: Move quickly through defaults.
paths.notes: Important for confidence: displayed defaults must actually work.

paths.name: Japanese hiragana reading aid defaults to VTT
paths.user_intent: Use true Japanese ruby output.
paths.notes: Needs careful copy because VTT ruby is great in asbplayer but uneven elsewhere.

paths.name: Modify+merge local path emits positional CLI correctly
paths.user_intent: Use local files without fetch.
paths.notes: Prevents confusing generated commands.

paths.name: Movie folder workflow
paths.user_intent: Process a movie-style folder rather than a TV season.
paths.notes: Checks movie-shaped filenames and S00E00 behavior.

paths.name: Existing merged output detected before run
paths.user_intent: Run a merge where the target file already exists.
paths.notes: Warns before dispatch so the user understands why merge may skip writing.

paths.name: Partial local subtitle coverage detected before run
paths.user_intent: Merge a folder where some episodes lack one requested language.
paths.notes: Shows missing episode/language examples before the command runs.

paths.name: No local subtitles found before run
paths.user_intent: Run a local merge on a folder that only contains video files.
paths.notes: Explains that the folder has no subtitle files and hints at extraction/fetch.

coverage_gaps.name: No online subtitles found, manual community search suggested
coverage_gaps.suggested_excerpt:
No downloadable subtitles were found for ja, ko.
Open community search pages now? [Y/n]

coverage_gaps.name: MKV contains embedded subtitles after online fetch misses
coverage_gaps.suggested_excerpt:
Online fetch did not find subtitles, but this MKV contains subtitle tracks.
Extract them and continue? [Y/n]
